unit.why: This is a halakhic and homiletic teaching that idle talk is forbidden on the Sabbath and that the wood-gatherer's sin was mundane speech. It cites the Yerushalmi (R. Shimon bar Yohai rebuking his mother) and a report of R. Yehiel Luria of Safed's custom only as supporting evidence, not as a narrated tale.
unit.boundary_note: Opens the letter ש section 'מענין שבת'. The next division continues the Sabbath teachings with a Besht saying from Toledot. The embedded anecdotes are too minimal to count as a separate story; the 'story (marginal)' label is not supported.
